description: Rejecting tracked deletions on a history-ot doc the way the live doc client now does it: a plain copy of the hidden text at the deletion, with the commentIds of every comment over it, and a raw delete of the hidden span in the same text operation. Carol (reviewer) and Bob (editor) are the Rust live doc client (live_doc_gate), Alice watches in the CE web editor, Dave listens on a scripted websocket. Carol deletes a commented word and two more words with tracking, Bob rejects one deletion and then two in one operation, and Alice types at the end. The CE web editor stays in sync throughout (compare history-ot-reject step 9, where clearing the tracking desynced it). Recorded on a throwaway project that is deleted at the end.
